name: AI Dunk Trend: Dunk in a Pro Game From One Photo
blurb: The AI dunk trend turns one photo into a pro basketball moment: you, in your everyday clothes, dribble down the court of a packed night game, slam the ball home with one hand and scream at the camera.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
An AI dunk trend video made from [Image 1]. Let the person in [Image 1] be the player who makes the dunk and recreate the dunk move; the scene stays a real pro basketball game at night. One continuous vertical 9:16 sports clip, filmed like a real TV broadcast camera at court level, photorealistic and sharp, with bright arena light.

The dunker is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), the same build, and the clothes and shoes from [Image 1]: everyday clothes, never a jersey or a uniform. The dunker is an adult. The same face from the first frame to the last, so their friends recognize them at once, also in the air and at the end. Never morph. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the dunker is that animal running upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

The place: a packed indoor pro basketball arena during a night game, a polished light hardwood court with plain painted lines and no logo at center court, a glass backboard with an orange rim and a white net, bright arena lights, a dark crowd filling the stands. The other players are generic adult players in plain navy and white jerseys with no names, no readable numbers and no team logos; a referee in a black-and-white striped shirt.

0-5 s: a side tracking shot at court level: the dunker dribbles the ball fast down the court with one hand, past a surprised defender, eyes on the rim; the crowd rises to its feet.
5-7.5 s: the dunker gathers the ball, takes two long steps, jumps high over a defender who reaches up, and slams the ball through the rim with one hand, hanging on the rim for a moment; the net snaps.
7.5-10 s: the dunker lands, turns straight to the camera in a close-up from the chest up and screams with joy and power, both fists clenched, the face large and sharp, the crowd going wild behind them.

Audio: sneakers squeaking, the ball bouncing on the hardwood, the crowd roaring, a loud rim clang, then the dunker's scream. No music, no lyrics, no commentary.

Exactly one ball. No league, team, college or arena logos, no team names, no sponsor boards with words, no scoreboard text, no captions, no watermark. No famous athlete: every other player and every fan is a generic adult. Anatomy rules: one head, two arms, two legs, five fingers on each hand; the dunker never merges with another player, the rim or the ball.
